test_title: PYST 31: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In the 2024 Jammu & Kashmir Assembly elections, from which constituency did the current Chief Minister of J&K contest, and which party does he/she represent?

options.text: Ganderbal, Jammu & Kashmir People's Democratic Party (JKPDP)

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ganderbal, Jammu & Kashmir National Conference (JKNC)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **current Chief Minister of Jammu & Kashmir** contested the 2024 Assembly Elections from the **Ganderbal constituency**.
 
• The **Ganderbal constituency** is located in the **Kashmir Valley region** of Jammu & Kashmir.
 
• The Chief Minister represents the **Jammu & Kashmir National Conference (JKNC)**, a prominent political party in the region.
 
• The **Jammu & Kashmir National Conference (JKNC)** is one of the oldest political parties in Jammu & Kashmir, known for its strong influence in the region.
 
• Historically, the **Ganderbal constituency** has been a significant political hub, often associated with key leaders of the National Conference.
 
• The **National Conference** has played a pivotal role in shaping the political landscape of Jammu & Kashmir, particularly in advocating for regional autonomy and development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Baramulla, Jammu & Kashmir National Conference (JKNC)**__

 __
 
• **Baramulla** is another important constituency in the Kashmir Valley. It is known for its strategic importance and diverse population.
 
• Although the National Conference has a presence in Baramulla, in the 2024 elections, the Chief Minister did not contest from this constituency.
 
 
 
• **Srinagar, Indian National Congress (INC)**__
 __
 
• **Srinagar** is the summer capital of Jammu & Kashmir and a key political center.
 
• The **Indian National Congress (INC)** is a national political party with representation in Jammu & Kashmir, but the Chief Minister represents the **National Conference**.
 
 
 
• **Jammu & Kashmir People's Democratic Party (JKPDP)**__
 
 
• The **Jammu & Kashmir People's Democratic Party (JKPDP)** is another major political party in the region, often known for its focus on reconciliation and peace-building.
 
• While JKPDP has influence in many areas, the Chief Minister is affiliated with the **National Conference**, not JKPDP.
